description:
Okay, I'm obsessed with this one. 😍
New in Killeen.

✨ 𝟰-𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗯𝗿𝗶𝗰𝗸 — all four sides. Built right.
🌳 𝗣𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗯𝗮𝗰𝗸𝘆𝗮𝗿𝗱 — extra-large covered patio, 6ft fence on a stone retaining wall.
🛏️ 𝗦𝗽𝗹𝗶𝘁 𝗯𝗲𝗱𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗺 𝗹𝗮𝘆𝗼𝘂𝘁 — huge owner's suite with a wet-zone ensuite: free-standing soaking tub + walk-in shower.
💼 𝗧𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗯𝗲𝗱𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗺 + 𝗼𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗲 — no carpet where it counts.
🏡 𝗩𝗮𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗰𝗲𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀 with a faux wood beam accent.
🍳 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻 𝗸𝗶𝘁𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗻 with a big island — made for entertaining.
📐 𝟮,𝟮𝟵𝟳 𝘀𝗾𝗳𝘁 on a 𝟬.𝟯𝟰 𝗮𝗰𝗿𝗲 𝗹𝗼𝘁.
🚗 Less than 𝟭𝟱 𝗺𝗶𝗻𝘂𝘁𝗲𝘀 from Fort Hood

Fun fact: the builder liked this design so much they used it as their model home. This one's even better — extra upgrades + a guest powder bath.
Come see it before someone else does. 👀

✨ 𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗶𝘀𝗵 𝗳𝗼𝗿 — and then some. ✨
